purpose: Administrator worksheet: replace each resource description with exact ARNs and construct scoped IAM statements before attaching. This is not an IAM policy.

groups.resources: housing-foundation read-only and housing-app CloudFormation stack/change sets
Dedicated SAM artifact bucket and web bucket only
Application CloudFormation service role only, if used

execution_role: CloudFormation also needs service permissions to manage the resources declared in application.yaml, including tightly scoped IAM creation/passing of application roles and secret reads. Have your account administrator define its permission boundary. Do not grant these permissions to pull-request jobs.
bootstrap: The first SAM --resolve-s3 deployment may create its managed artifact bucket/stack. Bootstrap that locally or provide a dedicated artifact bucket, then restrict CI to it.
